mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_purchase WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM biz_purchase WHERE purchase_no = #{purchaseNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.purchase_no, p.platform, p.platform_order_no, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT bp.product_name ORDER BY bp.product_name SEPARATOR '、') AS productName, p.supplier_name, p.seller_account, p.purchase_date, p.item_count, p.purchase_status, p.goods_amount, p.freight_amount, p.discount_amount, p.other_amount, p.pay_amount, p.payment_method, p.received_at, p.remark, p.created_at FROM biz_purchase p LEFT JOIN biz_purchase_item pi_name ON pi_name.purchase_id = p.id AND pi_name.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product bp ON bp.id = pi_name.product_id AND bp.deleted = 0
GROUP BY p.id, p.purchase_no, p.platform, p.platform_order_no, p.supplier_name, p.seller_account, p.purchase_date, p.item_count, p.purchase_status, p.goods_amount, p.freight_amount, p.discount_amount, p.other_amount, p.pay_amount, p.payment_method, p.received_at, p.remark, p.created_at ORDER BY p.purchase_date DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.pay_amount), 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.pay_amount FROM biz_purchase p LEFT JOIN biz_purchase_item pi_name ON pi_name.purchase_id = p.id AND pi_name.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product bp ON bp.id = pi_name.product_id AND bp.deleted = 0
GROUP BY p.id, p.pay_amount ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_purchase ( purchase_no, platform, platform_order_no, supplier_name, seller_account, purchase_date, item_count, purchase_status, goods_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, other_amount, pay_amount, invoice_status, payment_method, received_at, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{purchaseNo}, #{platform}, #{platformOrderNo}, #{supplierName}, #{sellerAccount}, #{purchaseDate}, #{itemCount}, #{purchaseStatus}, #{goodsAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{otherAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{receivedAt}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_purchase SET platform = #{platform}, platform_order_no = #{platformOrderNo}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, seller_account = #{sellerAccount}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE biz_purchase SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
